$comment: The Dry-Run Crane (Q0.7): a procedure with a dry run. It follows the course's setup script (.github/scripts/setup-training-scenarios.js): the dry run previews the repository a berth's ship stands for, and the run refuses one you don't own, stops outside a clone, and stops while your fork's workflows are off. The game owns the guards and the berths; this file says whose ship is where, what the script prints, and what Pim and Pol say. {yours} is the player's fork (or the placeholder).

text.actionsWarning: [dry-run] GitHub Actions is not active. Enable workflows at {url} before running with --yes.
text.actionsFailure: Setup failed: The Book app web workflow is not active. Open {url}, enable workflows for the fork, then rerun the setup script.
text.notARepoSign: run it from the root of a cloned Git repository.
text.actionsOffSign: The Book app web workflow is not active.
text.notARepo1: Run this script from the root
text.dryRunDone: Dry run complete. No changes were made.
text.noticeBefore: This crane runs the course’s setup script. Talk to Pim and Pol to start.
text.noticeAfter: This crane runs the course’s setup script, which adds practice items to your fork. It opens once your session’s ready: see Bo by the pier foot.
text.swingQuay: The crane swings back over the quay.
text.stillSwinging: Let her finish swinging first, Captain.
text.nothingQuay: Nothing to preview over the quay. The script only runs from the root of a cloned Git repository.
text.waitPreview: Wait for the preview to finish, then check the Repository line.
text.previewYoursActionsOff: Repository: {repository}. That’s your fork, but read the warning: GitHub Actions isn’t on yet. Workflows first!
text.previewYours: Repository: {repository}. That’s your fork. Now you can pull --yes.
text.previewCaptain: Repository: {repository}. That’s {who}’s fork, not yours. Turn the capstan.
text.previewGuild: Repository: {repository}. That one belongs to an organization, Captain.
text.yesQuay: That’s the quay! Run it from the root of a cloned Git repository.
text.previewFirst: Preview first, always! Pull Dry-Run and check the Repository line.
text.finishWithPol: Talk to Pol to finish up at the crane.
text.hintAim1: What does the sign say? Pull Dry-Run and read the Repository line.
text.hintAim2: Turn the capstan until the crane points at your own ship, Berth 1.
text.hintAim3: I’ve swung her round to your ship. Now preview it with Dry-Run.
text.hintPreview1: She’s aimed at your ship. What does a dry run show before you change anything?
text.hintPreview2: Pull the Dry-Run lever, the pale blue one on the left.
text.hintPreview3: There’s your preview. Check the Repository line.
text.hintActions1: Read the warning in that dry run. What has to be on before --yes?
text.hintActions2: Workflows first: pull the gate lever at Suri’s mill. It’s your fork’s Actions tab.
text.hintActions3: The compass points at Suri’s gate lever. Pull it, then come back for --yes.
text.hintYes1: The Repository line shows your fork. What runs it for real?
text.hintYes2: Pull the red --yes lever on the right.
text.hintYes3: Pulled it for you. Watch the hold fill.
